matched_prior_claims: The legacy natural-text test mean-replaced heads 11.3 and 15.5 jointly and changed restricted is/are accuracy only from 95.68% to 95.17%; it did not isolate head 11.3 or Task14 SELECT.
FIT donor interchange showed head 11.3 carries nearly all attention-11 transfer, while the other eight heads and their interaction contribute at most about 1.8% and 1.1% respectively.
FIT block-11 component replay established selective sufficiency of incoming state plus attention output, not zero-removal necessity of head 11.3.
SELECT matched-noun and cross-noun donor tests show stable head-11.3 transfer but contain no removal intervention.
novelty_delta: On all frozen SELECT A1/A2/P/C base endpoints, capture the native attention-11 preprojection state, then literally zero either head 11.3 or the whole attention-11 output only at the final prediction position. Replay the captured native head as an exact no-op instrument check. Score correct-margin damage in each semantic cell relative to the frozen median native A1/A2 margin.
decision_changed: If head-only removal damages every A1/A2 cell while P/C movement stays small, head 11.3 gains held-out within-task necessity. If full-attention removal is live but head-only removal is small, the carrier is sufficient but redundant under deletion. If P/C movement is large, the native head is an entangled unit that must be split before selective removal. Cross-circuit collateral remains a separate promotion gate.
